clause: This lease renews automatically for twelve (12) months unless Tenant gives ninety (90) days' written notice before expiry.

strict.reason: The automatic renewal clause could impose unexpected financial obligations or loss of control if the tenant fails to provide notice, even in an edge case.

generous.reason: The clause merely sets a renewal condition and does not directly impose a cost, loss of rights, or personal data requirement on the tenant.

adjudicator.plain: The lease will automatically renew for a twelve‑month period unless the tenant provides written notice at least ninety days before the lease expires.
adjudicator.action: Provide written notice to the landlord at least ninety days before the lease expiration date to prevent automatic renewal.
adjudicator.quote: This lease renews automatically for twelve (12) months unless Tenant gives ninety (90) days' written notice before expiry.
